subject.title: Dashboard: preview widget — live URL embed, dev-server preview, browser-backed inspection

question: What trusted preview-widget boundary should OpenClaw support for live URL embeds, agent-owned dev servers, and browser-backed inspection in the dashboard?
rationale: The request crosses new dashboard product surface, gateway/process ownership, and browser-data exposure boundaries that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Read-Only Preview First
options.body: Land only URL embed, reload, and viewport chrome after the dashboard substrate is accepted, leaving dev-server spawning and console/network inspection for separate security-reviewed follow-ups.

options.title: Fold Into Browser Panel Design
options.body: Make the older browser-preview and login-handoff issues the canonical design thread if maintainers want one broader browser surface instead of a dashboard-widget leaf.

options.title: Defer Until Wave 1 Lands
options.body: Keep this blocked until the dashboard store, builtin-widget, and custom-widget seams are merged and reviewed on main.

recommendation.title: Read-Only Preview First
recommendation.body: Land only URL embed, reload, and viewport chrome after the dashboard substrate is accepted, leaving dev-server spawning and console/network inspection for separate security-reviewed follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the current plugin-tab host through the Logbook PR and is the best available owner for the trusted Control UI/plugin product boundary.
